units: pixels and seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left
description: Side view of a military rocket-launcher truck (HIMARS-like, olive green, 3 axles) parked facing left on a desert road, launcher pod raised ~39 deg pointing up-left. A single rocket slides out of the pod's upper end and flies in a straight line up-left, accelerating, leaving the top of the frame. Camera fixed.

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of background patches vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.01 px in all frames)
camera.perspective: 2D side view; truck seen exactly side-on, horizon/dune ridge ~y 440-540; ground road band y ~840-900. Rocket flies in the image plane at (presumably) the truck's depth; one scale for the whole scene.

rocket.identify: the only moving object: slender grey-brown rocket (~17 px diameter) leaving the raised launcher pod, flying up-left at 39.0 deg above horizontal
rocket.visible_frames: nose tip first visible frame 3; partly visible (tail inside pod) frames 3-12; fully visible frames 13-21; nose beyond image top frames 22-25; gone from frame 26
rocket.reference_point: rocket centre (midpoint of nose and tail along the flight axis); during partial visibility = visible end -/+ L/2 along the axis

flight_axis.straightness: free-flight centroids lie on the line within 0.05 px; orientation constant

length_px.method: distance between 50%-of-plateau crossings of the along-axis profile of |frame - frame0| (blur-invariant), median of frames 13-21; raw d>30 mask length 226-240 px includes motion-blur smear

width_px.method: 1-99 percentile across-axis extent of d>30 mask, frames 13-22

rocket.axis_aligned_bbox_px_free_flight: axis span 157 x 127 px (x by y) for the 202 px rocket at 39 deg, ~168 x 140 including its 17 px diameter (unblurred estimate); blurred mask bbox about 185 x 147, see csv
rocket.speed_trend_px_per_frame_along_axis: centre advance ~16-20 px/frame at frames 4-6, ~37 at 12, ~48 at 15, ~57 at 20, ~61 at 23-24 (accelerating); for reference only, compute from csv

launcher_truck.identify: olive-green 3-axle truck, cab at left (facing left), flat chassis, launcher pod raised at rear
launcher_truck.note: rocks very slightly during launch: cab region up to 0.83 px upward (frames 2-13, peak frames 7-9), pod region up to 0.34 px downward; returns to rest by frame 14. Otherwise static.

launcher_pod.identify: grey-green box on the truck's rear, raised ~39 deg, upper end has a dark (charcoal) face and a thin rail arm with hook extending beyond it
launcher_pod.reliability: +-10 px (lower end merges with lifting gear)

road.identify: pale pinkish-grey dirt road strip under the truck

dunes_and_rocks.identify: sand dunes in background, ridge from y~440 (left) to ~500-540; small dark rock outcrops at right (e.g. x 1550-1700, y 590-640)

shadow.identify: truck shadow cast to the left on the ground, y ~815-860, x ~0-1000

events.event: rocket nose tip first visible at pod mouth
rocket tail leaves pod mouth (fully out)
first frame with whole rocket clearly free of pod
rocket last visible (tail stub at top edge)
